cases.task: In itsdangerous, Signer, Serializer, and their subclasses accept an empty sequence of secret keys (such as secret_key=[]) at initialization and silently produce an empty secret_keys list, which later crashes with IndexError when attempting to sign, unsign, derive a key, or access the secret_key property. Reject an empty secret_key sequence with ValueError mentioning secret_key at initialization time in _make_keys_list. Preserve existing behavior for single string/bytes and non-empty sequences. Add regression tests in tests/test_itsdangerous/test_signer.py and run the test suite.
